description: Icelandic company register (Fyrirtækjaskrá, Skatturinn): search companies by name (kennitala/ID number, name, address), or look up one company by its 10-digit kennitala for the full public record: name, registration date, other names, postal and legal address, municipality, legal form (ehf., hf., sf....), officers listed by the register, ÍSAT industry classification, and VAT numbers with registration dates. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

kennitala.description: 10-digit company ID (kennitala), e.g. 4612023490, for the full record

name.description: Company name to search, e.g. icelandair
